article.title: Review: “Communism, the Highest Stage of Ecology”
article.author: Editor
article.content: Writing about history, science and dialectical materialism, Suing keeps the present moment and important lessons for Marxist-Leninist cadres in mind: Communism, the Highest Stage of Ecology is not a nostalgic treatise or a theoretical exercise. It is an anti-imperialist, materialist analysis of our world. The post Review: “Communism, the Highest Stage of Ecology” appeared first on MR Online .
